utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up a few more things today — folks around the block have been really generous. If you want, I can pass along what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, is that right? What do they still need?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly cleaning supplies and a few sturdy blankets, I think. I can check and let you know the exact list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to swing by the repair drive later and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might be around later too, if I don’t get pulled into something else.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Nice, if you make it, we can compare notes on what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — could you bring a hammer, some screwdrivers, and a few sturdy work gloves?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring a hammer, screwdrivers, and sturdy work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m planning to stop by the repair drive later and see what they still need. If you’ve heard anything useful, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I haven’t heard a full list yet, but I can check what supplies are running low and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo — that would really help. I’ll check back with you later.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule, but I need to know what time the repair drive is happening first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still waiting on the final time too, but I’ll send it over as soon as I have it. Thanks for helping coordinate around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — just send me the time when you get it, and I’ll work around it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — let’s keep it simple. Tell me the plan for the repair drive, and I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, sorry — let’s keep it simple. I’ll gather the broken stuff, you help sort what’s fixable, and then we’ll drop it off together.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. I’ll sort the fixable items, and then we can drop them off together.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m telling folks about it now—want me to save you a spot or pass along the details?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please pass along the details—I’m a bit worried about timing and parking, so I’d like to know what to expect.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it starts at 10 a.m. on Saturday at the community center, and there’s street parking plus a few spots in the lot. If you want, I can also send the full rundown with the schedule and where to enter.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve been hearing bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’ve got a good start—people are signing up, and I’m sorting the list so we can match folks with the right repairs. If you’ve got any specific needs or know someone who does, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great—I’ll pass along anything I hear. I’m mostly getting this second-hand, so if there’s an easy way to send updates, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you share the repair drive details first so I can check them carefully?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — I’ll send over the repair drive details now so you can review them carefully.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — please send the details and I’ll check them carefully before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I’m keeping things pretty low-key right now. Let me know what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — I’ll keep it low-key too. I’ll let you know what I need when I’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good — just message me when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Tell me what you need, and I’ll see if I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — do you have a hammer, a screwdriver set, or a tape measure?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got all three — hammer, screwdriver set, and a tape measure. Just let me know which ones you want to borrow.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m tracking it carefully—where exactly is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s at the community hall on Maple, right by the library.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — the community hall on Maple by the library.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’ll let you know what tools would help most.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Rey — just give me a shout when you’ve got the list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the timing and how we’ll get everything there, but I’m happy to help if we can keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, so do we actually have a clear plan for timing and transport, or are we still figuring that out?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We’re still figuring it out, but I think we should set a pickup time and one clear drop-off point first. If we can nail the transport, the rest will be much easier.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — we still need a couple more volunteers to sort tools and someone to coordinate the sign-in table. If you can help connect either of those, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can ask around for a couple tool-sorters and see who can cover the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep an eye on supplies for the repair drive—what do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’m running a bit late, so I’ll stop by and see what’s still needed when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries, Dane — I’ll keep sorting the supplies until you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a lot of support already. I can swing by and tell you what I hear as things come in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be wonderful, Tess—thank you. I’m trying to keep track of donations around school pickup, so any updates you hear would really help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know what I hear around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what needs fixing, and when do you want me there?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — the main things are the loose fence panels, the hallway light, and a couple of porch steps. If you can come by Saturday morning around 10, that would be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday morning at 10 works for me — I’ll come by and help with those.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — could you spread the word and see who can bring tools or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and ask around for tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m happy to help spread the word for the repair drive—who should I invite first?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Maybe start with the folks on Maple Street and the apartment building by the corner—they’re usually in the loop, or at least I hear about them second-hand.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it—I’ll start with Maple Street and the corner apartments and let them know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked the repair drive yet, but I can help keep an eye on where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal. If you can keep an eye on it, I’ll check in on the usual spots and bring you a clear update.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll keep tracking any location updates and let you know if I spot where the repair drive settles.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — what time is the repair drive, and do you need me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — I’m checking the details now, so I don’t want to guess. I’ll let you know the exact time and whether you need to bring anything as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Hana — just let me know when you’ve confirmed it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting some good donations already—people around here are pitching in. I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s really nice of folks. I’ll keep an eye on it too, and if you hear anything, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m headed out now, so I’ll ask around and let you know if I hear anything helpful.
